title: tc-route-map
description: An app's routes as an indented list, with status, load time and last visit, filterable by status; pressing one opens it.

heading.description: The heading; empty leaves the header out

description.description: Small text under the heading – the site or environment

routes.description: The routes; children are indented under their parent

selected.description: The chosen route's id, or null

statuses.description: The statuses shown; empty shows every route

now.description: The time "last visited" counts to, in epoch ms; unset, the element keeps its own clock

maxHeight.description: Height in px at which the list scrolls; 0 for no limit

locale.description: The language for numbers and times, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

path.description: Such as "/grants/:id"; a child's path includes its parent's

name.description: A name for people, such as "Grant details"

lastVisited.description: When it was last visited, as an ISO date or epoch ms

loadMs.description: How long it took to load, in ms
